definitions.explanation: A natural lacquer made from the sap of the lacquer tree (urushi no ki). Used as a coating that hardens into a durable, glossy finish.
Objects coated with lacquer, such as bowls, trays, and boxes.

examples.japanese: {漆|うるし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{乾|かわ}く→乾く：00786_kawaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧。

{漆|うるし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{触|さわ}る→触る：00808_sawaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦かぶれる→かぶれる：06815_kabureru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Touching raw lacquer can cause a rash, so caution is needed.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{正月|しょうがつ}→お正月：05586_oshougatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{漆|うるし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{重箱|じゅうばこ}→重箱：22377_juubako⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。

examples.japanese: {輪島塗|わじまぬり}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{石川県|いしかわけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{漆器|しっき}→漆器：13329_shikki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{何層|なんそう}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{漆|うるし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねて→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧⟦{作|つく}られる→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。

notes:
USAGE:
{漆|うるし} can refer to the raw sap, the finished coating, or lacquerware objects. The formal/technical term for lacquerware objects is ⟦{漆器|しっき}→漆器：13329_shikki⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {漆|うるし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧: to apply lacquer
- {漆塗|うるしぬ}り: lacquer coating, lacquered
- ⟦{漆器|しっき}→漆器：13329_shikki⟧: lacquerware (formal term)
- {漆|うるし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧: lacquer tree

WATCH OUT:
Raw {漆|うるし} sap contains urushiol, which causes contact dermatitis (⟦かぶれ→かぶれ：25271_kabure⟧) in most people. The expression {漆|うるし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かぶれる→かぶれる：06815_kabureru⟧ (to get a lacquer rash) is well known.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese lacquerware has a history spanning thousands of years. The English word "japan" (lowercase) once meant lacquerware, reflecting Japan's association with the craft. Famous regional styles include {輪島塗|わじまぬり} and {会津塗|あいづぬり}.
